defaults.video_script: Ninety-fifth minute. Salah's penalty ended Egypt's twenty-eight year wait. October two thousand and seventeen, Alexandria. Egypt against Congo. Egypt have not been to a World Cup since nineteen ninety. They need a win to reach Russia. Sixty-third minute, Salah scores. One-nil. Congo equalise late. One-one. Stoppage time, a penalty. Salah steps up. He scores. Two-one. Egypt are going to the World Cup. Was this Salah's greatest moment for Egypt?
defaults.video_subject: On 8 October 2017 in Alexandria, Mohamed Salah scored both goals in Egypt's 2-1 win over Congo, including a 95th-minute penalty, sending Egypt to their first World Cup since 1990.
